title: Twin Children with two Fathers: Gay Marriage - DW Turkish
description: Johnny and Stefan are gay couple living in Germany. Thanks to a woman who donated her eggs and a carrier mother, she had twin children. Amalia and Aurelio recently celebrated their first birthdays. One of the children's father, Johnny, the other's Stefan. Johnny and Stefan, an example that a family does not necessarily have to consist of mother, father and child:

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a Deutsche Welle documentary about two fathers, their twins, egg donation, and surrogacy. Discussion of surrogate compensation and German reproductive-law restrictions is part of reporting on the family's experience, while scenes about parenting, relatives, and a first-birthday gathering support an observational family-life theme. The material does not ask viewers to pay, invest, provide credentials, or join a scheme.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is general documentary and lifestyle coverage of parenting, family relationships, reproductive arrangements and social experience, rather than a reward, investment, credential-request, recruitment or paid-guidance flow.
